text: Pilot hypothesis: artist and vendor intake completeness loop
description: Turn booking/vendor onboarding requirements into a goal-and-dependency graph: contracts, technical riders, travel, accommodation, accreditation, invoices, permits, and missing answers. Agents classify incoming material, propose reminders, and surface blockers; responsible humans approve communications and contractual choices. Measure coordinator hours per act/vendor, missing fields near deadline, reminder cycles, and late operational surprises. Avoid autonomous contract interpretation or commitments.

status.comment: Workflow hypothesis awaiting operator evidence; do not build before validating real pain, ownership, artifacts, baseline, and willingness to pay.
